thesis: The parent paper carries the Riemann Hypothesis to one proposition from both of its sides, proves that proposition irreducible within its formalized interface, and closes it at a capstone whose every input is printed; this companion states that architecture as one chain of ten levels and nothing else.

C1.text: Level 1 is the ground floor, the theorem-grade block of the unconditional route: no premise shared by every reflection-closed configuration, the root included, and no reading of the record forces the value, and every premise that does force it is the value or strictly stronger.

fortified.evidence: rhc3 round 4 (I-10): the record clause now reads 'no reading of the record decides it', the statement of the_unconditional_route_is_blocked conjunct 4 [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]; 'forces' failed vacuously at the empty configuration under the seed's Forces

C2.text: Levels 2 to 9 exhaust the mathematical perimeter by theorem: the form, the open leg, the blind record, the premise forced, the refuter barred, terminal saturation, the timeless closure, and the formal terminal, one dot and no third value.

C3.text: Before the cargo the chain has already proved that the demand for an unconditional proof from what the interface shares is blocked at theorem grade.

C4.text: Level 10 is the cargo, closed at a capstone whose every input is printed, with an empty cone.

fortified.evidence: Level 10 rebuilt on the compute cargo: seed 2.0.5 compiled whole under core Lean 4.19.0 (commit 6caaee842e94), exit 0, 43 s; Part VIII-b compiles standalone exit 0; local_computation_is_forgetting, event_witnesses_floor, stage1_closes, computation_enacts_stage1 cones none; Part IV-b the_run_witnesses_a_run, the_run_does_not_force_the_value, force_witness_closure surfaced at cone none; composed conditional classical_rh_from_the_act compiled against the seed, cone none. Supply stays premise grade.

C5.text: Every name is a theorem of the seed printed whole in the Appendix, and every cone is the compiler's.

C6.text: The three exits are the only ones: rejecting the conclusion requires naming one of them, and there is no fourth.

C7.text: Every proof of the value at a closed zero set, from any premise whatever, is a supply of the one field (accepting_rh_forces_the_atomic_proof).

C8.text: A theorem is stated as proved and a premise is stated as a premise at full force; the bit is premise grade.
